title: feat(plugins): add Rust url_reputation plugin
summary: - Implement URL reputation engine in Rust (engine.rs) with heuristic, IANA TLD, and pattern-based filters - Expose plugin via PyO3 as `url_reputation_rust` Python extension - Update Python fallback in plugins/url_reputation/url_reputation.py - Add benchmarks, performance comparison script, and stub typings - Expand unit tests to cover Rust-backed and Python implementations The plugin takes less than 7 microseconds to execute. ## 🔗 Related Issue Closes #2907 --- ## 📝 Summary _What does this PR do and why?_ Implements a Rust-accelerated `url_reputation` plugin using PyO3, replacing the performance-limited Python-only path for URL validation. - **Rust engine** (`plugins_rust/url_reputation/`): heuristic checks (Shannon entropy, IANA TLD validation, Unicode/homoglyph detection), domain whitelist/blocklist, and regex pattern filtering - **PyO3 binding**: exposes `URLReputationPlugin.validate_url_py()` returning a plain Python dict; the Python wrapper imports it at runtime with a graceful fallback - **Python fallback** (`plugins/url_reputation/url_reputation.py`): retained for environments where the Rust extension is unavailable; heuristic and regex features are Rust-only - **Benchmarks**: Criterion bench suite and `compare_performance.py` script for Python vs Rust comparison - **Tests**: expanded unit tests cover both the Rust engine (via `#[cfg(test)]`) and the Python wrapper (with and without Rust available) - **Stub typings** (`url_reputation_rust.pyi`): minimal stub exposing only the Python-facing API --- ## 🏷️ Type of Change - [ ] Bug fix - [X] Feature / Enhancement - [ ] Documentation - [X] Refactor - [ ] Chore (deps, CI, tooling) - [ ] Other (describe below) --- ## 🧪 Verification | Check | Command | Status | |---------------------------|-----------------|--------| | Lint suite | `make lint` | Ok | | Unit tests | `make test` | Ok | | Coverage ≥ 80% | `make coverage` | Ok | --- ## ✅ Checklist - [X] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`) - [X] Tests added/updated for changes - [X] Documentation updated (if applicable) - No secrets or credentials committed [X] > > --- ## 📓 Notes (optional) _Screenshots, design decisions, or additional context._
reasoning:
- Implement URL reputation engine in Rust (engine.rs) with heuristic, IANA TLD, and pattern-based filters
- Expose plugin via PyO3 as `url_reputation_rust` Python extension
- Update Python fallback in plugins/url_reputation/url_reputation.py
- Add benchmarks, performance comparison script, and stub typings
- Expand unit tests to cover Rust-backed and Python implementations

The plugin takes less than 7 microseconds to execute.
